column3: “From the south” is rendered “to the south.”
“Cord of linen” is rendered “line of flax.”
“House” is rendered “temple,” and NASB has “a cubit and a handbreadth.”
The Hebrew repeats “threshold … one rod”; NASB has “the other threshold.”
“Entrance before entrance” is rendered “from one door to the door opposite.”
The Hebrew is difficult (“he made pillars sixty cubits”); NASB has “sixty cubits high.” The meaning is uncertain.
NASB puts “that is, the lower pavement” in parentheses.
NASB keeps this verse, which the LXX omits.
